conditions.evidence: Seven healthy participants underwent brain PET imaging
conditions.label: healthy participants

modalities.evidence: Seven healthy participants underwent brain PET imaging

output.population: Seven healthy human participants (two high-affinity, three mixed-affinity, two low-affinity binders) aged 33–56; two additional participants received whole-body scans
output.summary: Brain PET imaging of the novel TSPO radioligand [18F]SF51 in healthy adults, plus whole-body scans for dosimetry. Binding in human brain was low despite good performance in nonhuman primates.
